description: Geofabrik Switzerland 2026-09-02; bus graph with service roads and strict stop candidates
filtering: pfaedle -X type/tag filter using retained filter.cfg and filter-patterns.json. The national filtered graph is retained, not claimed to be spatially clipped. Matching covers the complete three-route fixture scope; no border supplement required. Filter profile adds highway=service; original access, turn and road-class rules remain.
routing: Retained routing.cfg adds highway=service to the keep list and tightens bus OSM station-candidate and edge-snap distances to 20 m. Original road-access/turn penalties retained; no official bus-access certification.
qualification: Inferred bus corridors, including explicit short GTFS-platform attachments. Not operator-verified directions or temporary diversions.
